title: Trial Trophies and Loot
description: Adds some trophies that can be obtained in certain ways, use these trophies to get OP rewards!
body:
![Trials Trophies and Loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c35fb8c4bd2f948a00d332e0463085b740029ace.png)

# !!⚠️ALL RECIPES ARE FOUND IN THE GALLERY⚠️!!

### _What This Mod Contains!_
- When you kill **125 Monsters**, you get one Iron Trophy! **_(Obtainable Inf Times)_**
- When you kill **250 Monsters**, you get one Golden Trophy! **_(Obtainable Inf Times)_**
- When you kill **a Warden**, you get a Warden Trophy, and an Advancement!!! **_(Obtainable only ONCE)_**
- Contains new blocks including a block you use to trade your trophies in for OP loot!
- At **500 Monster kills**, you get a very powerful scythe, _**(you can only obtain this scythe ONCE, so make sure to repair it using either bones, emeralds or diamonds in an anvil!)**_
- Reinforced Gold Tools including: Reinforced Gold Pickaxe, Reinforced Gold Axe, and Reinforced Gold Sword!
- Diamond Shard, grab a normal diamond and right click either stone, cobblestone, deepslate, or cobbled deepslate to get diamond shards! **_(Used to make Reinforced Gold Ingot!)_**


- **_I have also made it so when you get a Trial Spawner, (from the Warden Trophy loot drop) when you place a Trial Spawner it gets a Tag that lets players mine it back up, but already generated ones you cant obtain through mining!_**
